notes.subject: עם שמש
notes.rationale: 'le letsatsi' (mmoho le letsatsi) kgahlanong le 'ho fihlela letsatsi le ntse le le teng' (KJV/JPS/ASV); Seheberu se re 'mmoho le letsatsi'.

notes.subject: דור דורים
notes.rationale: Tlhahloso e ka sehloohong: 'molokoloko wa melokoloko' — sebopeho sa 'generation of generations' se bolokwa.

notes.subject: uena
notes.rationale: Moriri wa sehlahisoaving (‑ך) o hlokahala ho Sesotho joalo ka sehlahisoavi se itseng, o behilwe ka ⟨uena⟩ phetolelong... o ngotswe ka ho toba 'ba tla ho tshaba uena'.

translation: Ba tla ho tshaba Yahwe le letsatsi, mme pele ho kgwedi, molokoloko wa melokoloko.
